title: ec2-hetero-fleet.sh: locale-dependent [0-9] regex on RENODE_PORT_BASE validation
description: Security review FYI follow-up of 048n. scripts/ec2-hetero-fleet.sh:104 uses [[ "$RENODE_PORT_BASE" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] - same collation-dependent range class as the fleet-guards CYCLE_MIN bug; under UTF-8 locales Unicode digits can pass and flow into a numeric context. Fix similarly: explicit [0123456789] in the regex or coerce with validation arithmetic.
